headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 22, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees suffered a 3-5 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Amed Rosario leading the Yankees' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. Framber Valdez earned the win for the Tigers, pitching 6.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Blas Castaño, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026. Additionally, Josh Ekness has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right calf strain, while Liam Hicks has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 20, 2026, with a low back strain.

The Atlanta Braves bolstered their bullpen with the addition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff, acquired from the Washington Nationals. Other notable roster moves include the trade of Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros, and the trade of Luis Urías from the Arizona Diamondbacks to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Rays in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals edged out the Tampa Bay Rays 2-1, with Michael Wacha pitching 7.0 innings and allowing just 1 ER. Alex Lange secured the save for the Royals.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Marlins in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 4-3. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Phillies in 4-1 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Foster Griffin pitching 7.1 innings and allowing just 1 earned run. Curtis Mead led the Phillies' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.
